title: ID0432023-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / P0 312567479/19] Charging station unavailable
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: The charging stations cannot be selected and are unavailable.
The charging station has been electrically rebooted and its status remains the same.
The charging station has been in this state for three weeks.
In the Help tab on the charging station, it says "version: undefined."
R&D ticket: EVC3-9741

additional_info.subject: 0432023 - ID0432023-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / P0 312567479/19] Charging station unavailable CRM:00362000063
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Firstly, let me thank Franck for the accurate reporting and prompt actions on this case.
I'd like to express my sincerest thanks to Franck and the RC-FR team for timely:
Addressing the current Status
Reporting the anormalities on site
Reporting the troubleshooting activities in this ticket
Attaching the dump data to this ticket
As per reported by Franck, a critical issue with this charger has been found and solved by config restore.
The Cloud team has notified me that the charger was generating an abnormally high volume of logs (35GB over the past 7 days), which is significantly above the expected threshold.
This situation required immediate attention as the excessive logging was causing:
Increased operational costs
Potential data loss
Performance issues
System throttling
R&D is currently working on a solution to minimize the chance of data corruption and minimize the log spam.
In addition, I noticed that more chargers had faults about corrupted data like this one. On this matter, I'd kindly ask you to report them via ISP and attach the dump data whenever applicable.
Whenever you'd be reporting a case of data corruption/lost config, please ask in the ticket to forward the ticket to L3 queue to report the corrupted data to R&D. Your help on this matter is absolutely precious.
Once again, I sincerely thank you for the great work!
With best regards,
Michele Sambiagio
